thread:
Priya Kapoor: heads up — got paged for a regional embeddings regression, eu-west1. saw a flurry of 503s and p95 for embeddings >3s starting ~08:12 UTC. paging stopped after initial mitigation but forwarding handoff now.

Oncall Bot: INCIDENT #57321 created (embeddings-eu-west1-region-degraded) — pages sent to @pri, @jordan. Triggers: 5xx spike from embedding-service, node-level GPU driver errors reported.

Priya Kapoor: quick timeline: 08:11 alert -> 08:13 page -> 08:20 fallback routing to cpu-embeddings applied (automated policy) -> 08:22 partial recovery for some traffic but latency remains ~1.5s. primary cause looks like NV driver crashes on 3 nodes in rack-3. logs attached to incident.

Jordan L.: saw the same. kernel message `NVRM: GPU at 0000:3B:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus` repeated in node logs. kdmp and driver restarts failed on two nodes (OOM-ish).

Sam Wu: tagging runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-gpu-failures — follow immediate remediation steps, section "region degraded -> fallback, restart path".

Priya Kapoor: actions taken so far:
- routed all non-SLA-critical customers in eu-west1 to `cpu-embeddings-v2` via routing policy (reduced cost but higher latency).
- scaled up warm CPU pool for embeddings by +4 nodes to soften tail.
- marked 3 nodes in rack-3 as unschedulable and created maintenance tickets.

Alex R.: current impact: ~12% of embeddings requests hit fallback. Customer-facing errors were ~4% at peak (mostly 503 -> retriable). Affected customers: internal integration tests + 2 small customers; enterprise customers were on dedicated capacity and unaffected.

Priya Kapoor: runbook checklist (short):
1) confirm driver crash signatures: `journalctl -u nv-driver -u kubelet -b` on nodes.
2) cordon + drain bad nodes: `kubectl cordon <node>; kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
3) attempt driver reattach: `sudo systemctl restart nv-driver && dmesg | tail -n 60`
4) if repeated, reprovision from spare pool (note capacity impact).

Jordan L.: I ran logs and got consecutive `GPU hung, killing process` messages — looks like a memory leak in the latest driver build on that node family. Opened engineering bug: INF-9821. Linking: https://internal.redwood/board/INF-9821

Oncall Bot: Pager resolved for now — routing fallback engaged and error rate dropped below alert threshold at 08:30. Incident remains open for remediation and root cause.

Sam Wu: quick commands I used to scale warm pool: 
```
# increase cpu warm pool for embeddings
redwood infra pools update embeddings-cpu-warm --size +4 --region eu-west1
```
Also applied a transient traffic-shape rule to throttle non-interactive workloads to reduce burst.

Priya Kapoor: handoff notes for next shift (Jordan you're staying on as secondary):
- Primary: Jordan L. (oncoming)
- Secondary: Alex R. (backup)
- Coverage gap: none expected but spare GPU inventory is low in eu-west1 (spare count = 2), coordinate with capacity for reprovisioning if more nodes fail.

Jordan L.: thanks. immediate next steps I will own:
- validate the 3 cordoned nodes' kernel/driver state at 09:00 UTC and attempt one controlled reprovision if driver restart fails.
- follow INF-9821 for upstream driver rollback candidate; coordinate with infra-release if rollback required.
- confirm all customers on fallback are within SLA fallback policy and notify support if any regressions persist.

Alex R.: I'll keep watch on metrics: embeddings 5xx rate, p95, and routing split. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/embeddings-eu-west1 — set to refresh 30s.

Priya Kapoor: outstanding action items (assignments):
- Jordan: driver reprovision + update INF-9821 (status + logs) — due 09:30 UTC.
- Alex: monitor dashboards & escalate if fallback >25% traffic or p95 >2s — ongoing.
- Sam: engage capacity team to queue spare GPU nodes for reprovision — pinged via #capacity (ticket CAP-445).

Jordan L.: one more note — the current fallback model (`cpu-embeddings-v2`) has slightly different embeddings dimensionality but we mapped outputs in the service shim. tests looked ok but please flag any semantic differences to product.

Priya Kapoor: customer comms: support notified for the two small customers; we should prepare a short post-incident note once we have root cause. No enterprise customers impacted.

Oncall Bot: reminder: add postmortem tag `region-fallback-embeddings` to incident #57321 and set severity S2 if reprovision required.

Priya Kapoor: end handoff — I am heading offline. Please update this thread with status changes. Attaching quick snippets from the node where repro worked: 
```
May 12 08:18 node-3b kernel: NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus
May 12 08:19 node-3b systemd: nv-driver restarted
May 12 08:20 embedding-service: route adjusted -> cpu-embeddings-v2
```

Jordan L.: ack, taking primary. will post updates. :thumbsup:

Alex R.: ack and monitoring.

Sam Wu: acked, capacity pinged.

Priya Kapoor: thanks all — handing off.
